name: CoinMarketCap
tagline: Market data API for cryptocurrency prices, market caps, and exchange metrics
description: CoinMarketCap provides a RESTful cryptocurrency market data API covering prices, market capitalization, volume, rankings, historical OHLCV, exchange listings, and metadata for thousands of digital assets. Developers use it for portfolio trackers, trading bots, dashboards, and research tools. Access is API-key authenticated with tiered free and paid plans; endpoints return JSON and enforce plan-based rate and credit limits.

auth.details: API key via X-CMC_PRO_API_KEY header (or query param CMC_PRO_API_KEY); self-serve signup at coinmarketcap.com/api

pricing.free_tier_limits: Basic/Hobbyist free plan with monthly credit allotment (commonly cited ~10,000 credits/month; confirm on current pricing page)
pricing.paid_plans: Startup, Standard, Professional, Enterprise tiers with higher credits and call rates

rate_limits: Plan-based monthly credits and per-minute request limits; exact numbers vary by tier — see pricing/docs
use_cases: get latest USD price and market cap for a cryptocurrency by symbol
list top cryptocurrencies ranked by market capitalization
fetch historical OHLCV candles for a coin
look up coin metadata (logo, website, tags) by CMC id or slug
get exchange listings and pair quotes for a market
convert crypto amounts between currencies using live rates
